Keep text legible spelled M-O-V-E-R-N-O, no extra words, no label headings, no diagram or arrows, no new side logos or extra hardware, no colored accents beyond source. Do not paint lettering over existing cage or wrap straps. High quality photorealistic concept. NOT a techpack/measurement drawing.
